sections.description: Mimam's Var - WP is a modular design-system operating layer inside WordPress. Centralize your CSS variables, manage theme scales, configure fluid scales, build layout utility structures, and sync seamlessly with Figma.
sections.changelog:
v1.3.117 - Dev

  • Implemented Direct Canvas Iframe settings and rerenderElementIds Synchronization: Direct same-origin Vue state synchronization for bulk operations. Previously, when mutating element settings on non-selected elements inside the top window, the canvas in the iframe did not update. This is because Bricks' native message postMessage watcher explicitly excludes the 'components' key from synchronization, and the 'rerenderElementIds' array is also excluded. As a result, the iframe's element Vue properties remained stale and elements did not receive a rerender signal. We now locate the same element inside the iframe's Vue elements list directly and overwrite its settings, and push the element's ID directly to the iframe's Vue state 'rerenderElementIds' array. This triggers the element component's watcher inside the iframe to immediately fetch the updated HTML from the server and update the canvas preview.
  • Added Detailed Console Logging for Bulk Operations: Integrated info and warning console logs to trace bulk matching checks (matchesBulkTarget), element counts, resolved tags, direct settings overrides, and re-renders, making debugging in browser developer tools extremely transparent.

v1.3.116 - Dev

  • Fixed Nestable and Layout Element Bulk Tag Matching: Added full support for customTag and _customTag setting fields inside BricksAdapter.getElementTagName. Previously, when a user set a custom tag override on a Div/Block element to 'li', the settings only stored '_tag: custom' and '_customTag: li'. Since _customTag was completely missing from the settings candidates list, it fell back to 'div', causing tag-targeted bulk commands (e.g. 'all li => ...') to skip matching these overridden elements.
  • Fixed Active Component/Template Element List Support: Updated getMutableElementsRoot to support active component/template element lists. If a user is active inside a Bricks component/template, the elements array resides in state.activeComponent.elements instead of globals.$_dynamicElements.value.
